title: Model Landscape Competitive Mosaic and Regional Pricing Sensitivity Synthesis
creator: Arielle Chen
description: Synthesize competitive signals for open and closed LLMs across NA/EU/APAC with a focus on pricing sensitivity by use-case (embeddings, chat, bulk generation). Deliver a concise mosaic: a prioritized heatmap of model fit, regional price elasticity estimates, recommended monitoring triggers, and a short experiment plan for validating pricing sensitivity on Redwood Hosted API. This is an operational intelligence doc meant to inform pricing, routing policies, and Dedicated sales guidance.
deliverables: 1-page executive mosaic (PDF) summarizing top 8 model variants and regional fit
CSV dataset of model benchmarks and price points used in analysis
Pricing sensitivity heuristics and a proposed A/B test plan for Hosted API
Watchlist of models to monitor with suggested evaluation prompts and metrics
acceptance_criteria: Executive mosaic prepared and reviewed by PM and GTM lead
Benchmarks include latency, inferred per-token cost, quality proxy (Rerank / ROUGE / embedding dot distribution), and geographic availability
A/B test plan includes sample sizes, success metrics (unit cost delta, quality drift), and rollback criteria
Stakeholder sign-off (Product, Sales, Research) obtained before handoff to Analytics
tasks: Collect canonical pricing and quota offers for top providers and open models (NA/EU/APAC)
Run lightweight evals on representative prompts for 4 verticals: search, summarization, customer support, embeddings
Estimate per-token marginal cost for Redwood Hosted vs. Dedicated vs. private-hosted equivalents
Interview 3 large customers for sensitivity anecdotes and price thresholds
Draft A/B test matrix and hand to analytics for power calculation
risks_and_mitigation: Pricing data is noisy and rapidly changing — mitigate by capturing timestamps and source links for every price point
Quality proxies may not map to end-user metrics — mitigate with small qualitative user studies for 2 customers
Regional availability can be misreported — cross-validate with provider region docs and simple API probes
